_comment: Minimum acceptable REAL translation coverage per locale (percent of keys whose value differs from English). The coverage ratchet (scripts/check-i18n-coverage-ratchet.mjs) fails the build if any active locale drops below these floors — so adding untranslated English keys can never silently lower coverage. Floors sit ~1 point below the measured coverage to tolerate small churn. Raise them as real translations land; never lower them. Hindi is intentionally hidden (enableHindiLocale=false) until its column is completed, so its floor is informational.
